subject: calculating standard errors for lambda in occuRN

messages.author: 070822d448e38581
messages.subject: calculating standard errors for lambda in occuRN
parts:
Dear All,

I would like to calculate standard errors for average site abundance (lambda) for my study area

I use this to estimate site abundance for each site:

surv_predsm8<-predict(m8, type="state", newdata=udf)

lambda for the survey area should be:

m8lambda_surv<-mean(surv_predsm8$Predicted)

I can not simply take a mean of the surv_predsm8$SE to get the standard error for lambda?

Thanks for any help

Chris

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] calculating standard errors for lambda in occuRN
parts:
hi Chris 
I recommend bootstrapping the SE

you could compute it using standard formulas but there are a bunch of covariance terms to keep track of and you would have to do it the old fashioned way (ie look up the formulas and plug and chug )

if you wrongly assume the lambdahats are independent then the var of the mean is (1/n)^2 *[ sum of variances ]

regards 
Andy
